name: SurrealDB
tagline: Rust multi-model database (documents, graph, vectors, live queries) that runs embedded, in WASM or clustered.
description: SurrealDB is a Rust database that combines document, graph (record links and RELATE edges), key-value, full-text and vector search behind SurrealQL, a SQL-like language with graph traversal syntax. The same engine runs in-memory, on disk via RocksDB or SurrealKV, in the browser through WebAssembly, or distributed on TiKV. It adds row-level permissions, so clients can connect directly. Version 3.0 (February 2026) focused on stability and AI-agent memory use cases, and 3.3.4 shipped in October 2026. It is ambitious and evolving quickly, so it is well suited to new apps that want one flexible backend, but check the BSL terms and test maturity for heavy production.

license.name: Business Source License 1.1 (converts to Apache 2.0 after 4 years)

pricing.notes: Free to self-host except as a commercial DBaaS; Surreal Cloud has a free tier and paid instances; enterprise licences available.

scale.notes: Single-node by default; horizontal scale comes from running compute nodes over a distributed TiKV storage cluster.

strengths: Documents, graph edges, vectors and full-text search in one engine and one query language
Runs embedded, in the browser via WASM, single-node or on TiKV
LIVE SELECT pushes realtime changes to clients
Row-level permissions and built-in auth let frontends query directly
weaknesses: Young engine; performance and stability have varied between releases
BSL licence prohibits offering it as a commercial DBaaS
Distributed mode depends on operating a separate TiKV cluster
Tooling, ORMs and operational knowledge are still thin
useCases: Greenfield apps wanting one backend for documents and relationships
Agent memory and knowledge graphs for AI applications
Local-first or in-browser data with WASM
notIdealFor: Conservative enterprises needing a decade of production track record
Companies planning to resell it as a hosted service
